headline: Name the 5 layers of the scalp
stat_note: The word itself is the mnemonic: SCALP
body:
S = Skin
C = Connective tissue (dense)
A = Aponeurosis (galea aponeurotica)
L = Loose areolar connective tissue
P = Pericranium
source: Source: StatPearls (NCBI), Anatomy, Head and Neck, Scalp

headline: Most of your eye's light sensors can't see color
body: Rods help you see in dim light but detect no color. Cones need brighter light and handle color and detail; most sit in the macula.

headline: Your spinal cord is shorter than your spine
stat_note: where the adult spinal cord ends
body: The vertebral column grows faster than the spinal cord. The cord tapers into the conus medullaris, and the nerve roots below it form the cauda equina.
source: Source: TTUHSC El Paso Gross Anatomy; Cleveland Clinic
